executive_summary.scope: HT-082 final focused live sanity check after bounded correction
notes: Dashboard loaded normally under the existing local admin session with populated KPI cards, inventory breakdown links, and recent activity.
The recent device item HT075-DeviceLive-Z still linked through to the scoped topology route with workspace_id, topology_id, and device_id present.
Inventory loaded normally and exposed the HT075-DeviceLive-Z row without errors.
Opening the delete confirmation dialog for HT075-DeviceLive-Z no longer reported that the device had no placements.
The same dialog reported 9 topology placements and listed historical version and ghost labels, which looks inconsistent with current-layout-only counting semantics.

prioritized_issues.title: Inventory delete dialog placement count includes historical topology noise
prioritized_issues.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open http://localhost:8080/ as admin@hometower.local. 2. Confirm dashboard shows recent activity item HT075-DeviceLive-Z and click it to verify the scoped topology route. 3. Navigate to /inventory. 4. Find HT075-DeviceLive-Z and click Delete device from inventory. 5. Observe the dialog reports 9 topology placements with historical Version, Restore, Recreate ghost, and Map ghost entries instead of a clean current-layout-only count.

action_log.result: Opened http://localhost:8080/ and confirmed the app was already authenticated as admin@hometower.local.
Verified the dashboard rendered normally with summary cards, inventory breakdown links, and recent activity items including HT075-DeviceLive-Z.
Opened /inventory and confirmed HT075-DeviceLive-Z was present and rendered normally in the inventory table.

Opened the delete confirmation dialog for HT075-DeviceLive-Z and observed placement detection was active, but the count was 9 with historical version and ghost entries rather than an obviously current-layout-only placement list.
